paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Metzia 86b, where he reported in Rav’s name.[^1]

notes.text: The source names Rav as the reported authority but supplies no saying; He refers contextually to Guryon ben Astyon. ב״מ פו: is conventionally Bava Metzia86b, without named-edition verification. Guryon is not harmonized to the Gurayin form of another notice.
